# Environment variables

<!-- Generated by `go run ./tools/docgen`. Do not edit by hand: change the code and regenerate. -->

Container-level settings only. Everything else (indexers, Usenet servers, naming, VPN, notifications) is set in the app under Settings, not here. `PUID`, `PGID` and `TZ` are read by the container entrypoint, not by the app.

| Variable | Default |
|---|---|
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | `` |
| `APP_PORT` | `8264` |
| `AUDIOBOOKS_DIR` | `/audiobooks` |
| `BUNDLED_FLARESOLVERR` | `` |
| `CONFIG_DIR` | `/config` |
| `DOWNLOADS_DIR` | `/downloads` |
| `EBOOKS_DIR` | `/ebooks` |
| `MEDIARIUM_IMAGE_VERSION` | `` |
| `MEDIARIUM_PAUSE_AUTOMATION` | `` |
| `MEDIARIUM_SUPERVISED` | `` |
| `MOVIES_DIR` | `/movies` |
| `MUSIC_DIR` | `/music` |
| `TRUSTED_PROXIES` | `private` |
| `TV_DIR` | `/tv` |
| `PUID` | `1000` |
| `PGID` | `1000` |
| `TZ` | `Etc/UTC` |
